portals.label: Library
portals.description: Books and longer teachings published from the shared AFFiNE workspace.

pages.title: At the Service of Destiny
pages.description: A biography of Shaykh Mohamed Faouzi al-Karkari — how a young orphan became a blacksmith of hearts, absorbed in the Divine Presence and occupied with the purification of hearts.

pages.title: Candles on the Path
pages.description: Excerpts from the teachings of Shaykh Mohamed Faouzi al-Karkari on spiritual guidance, visions of Light, and the practical wisdom of the Sufi path.

pages.title: Etiquette of Spiritual Companionship
pages.description: A study of the conditions for embarking on the spiritual journey with a divinely connected walī, and the gravity of the Shaykh's holy assembly.

pages.title: Guided By The Divine Light
pages.description: Notes from the Shaykh's lectures responding to disciples' questions about their visions of Light and spiritual experiences, across thirty chapters.

pages.title: In the Footsteps of Moses
pages.description: A contemporary Sufi commentary on the story of God's Confidant (kalīm Allāh) in the Qurʾān — Moses' birth, training under Shuʿayb, Mount Ṭūr, the Red Sea, and al-Khiḍr.

pages.title: Introduction to Islamic Metaphysics
pages.description: A Sufi treatise mapping the mystical journey to God as an initiatic progression through seven degrees of realization of the divine Name Allāh.

pages.title: Sufism Revived
pages.description: A contemporary treatise on divine Light, prophecy, and sainthood — Sufi commentary on the degrees of prophethood (nubūwa), messengerhood (risāla), and sainthood (wilāya).

pages.title: The Foundations of the Karkariya Order
pages.description: The seven foundational principles of the spiritual path — the Pact, the Sacred Dance, the Patched Cloak, the Singular Name, Wandering, the Spiritual Retreat, and the Innermost Secret.

pages.title: The Sufi Path of Light
pages.description: A major contemporary treatise on divine Light in the Qurʾān, the Hadith, and the Sufi tradition, with commentary on the Light Verse and the aphorisms of Ibn ʿAṭāʾ Illāh.

pages.title: Wisdoms of the Heart
pages.description: A collection of mudhākara (spiritual discourses) on self-knowledge, the nafs, and the necessity of a living Shaykh for the seeker.

pages.title: Zamzam of Spiritual Knowledge
pages.description: A guide to how the Shaykh navigates the disciple through the body's vessels to the heart, where the divine secret — the disciple's Zamzam — is experienced.

portals.label: Media library
portals.description: Reviewed recordings and transcripts published from AFFiNE.

recent.title: Origins of the Tariqa Karkariya
recent.description: How the Karkariya emerged from the Shadhili-Alawi lineage in contemporary Morocco.

recent.description: Founder of the Shadhiliyya order and the central ancestral figure of the Karkariya lineage.

keyTerms.title: Bay'a
keyTerms.description: The act of initiation into the Tariqa — the pledge of allegiance between murid and Shaykh.

keyTerms.title: Faqr
keyTerms.description: Spiritual poverty — the station of total dependence on God and freedom from all but Him.

keyTerms.title: Hadra
keyTerms.description: The collective spiritual gathering of the Tariqa, combining dhikr, poetry, and presence.

keyTerms.title: Ism al-Mufrad
keyTerms.description: The Singular Name — the dhikr of the divine name "Allah" as the heart's sole occupation.

keyTerms.title: Khalwa
keyTerms.description: Spiritual retreat; a period of seclusion undertaken for intensive worship and purification.

keyTerms.title: Muraqqa'
keyTerms.description: Spiritual watchfulness and contemplative meditation; the practice of inner vigilance.

keyTerms.title: Murid
keyTerms.description: The spiritual aspirant who has taken initiation (bay'a) into the Tariqa.

keyTerms.title: Silsila
keyTerms.description: The initiatic chain of transmission connecting the present Shaykh back to the Prophet ﷺ through an unbroken line of masters.

keyTerms.title: Sirr
keyTerms.description: The innermost secret of the heart; the deepest faculty of the human being, where divine disclosure occurs.

keyTerms.title: Siyaha
keyTerms.description: Spiritual wandering or journey; the practice of leaving one's familiar world for the sake of God.
